label: Frontend response type interfaces
instruction: Generate only types.ts, max45 lines, exported TypeScript interfaces matching existing backend serializer/model fields: LeaveApplication(id:number,user_id:number,status:string,leave_type:number,start_date:string,end_date:string,purpose:string), LeaveBalance(id:number,user_id:number,leave_category:number,balance:string), LeaveTask(id:number,user_id:number,leave_application:number,task_type:string,status:string). LeaveHistory(id:number,status:string,decision:string) and LeaveNotification(id:number,message:string). No runtime code or business fixes.
